title: The Truth Kiran Carried
content:
The days continued to move forward.

But I didn't.

While time carried everyone else ahead, I found myself trapped in the same memories, unable to let go.

Every morning, I woke up hoping something would change.

Every night, I went to sleep with the same unanswered questions.

Slowly...

The loneliness began turning into depression.

Throughout those difficult days, there was only one person who never left my side.

Yashwanth.

Whenever I was happy, he celebrated with me.

Whenever I was broken, he stood beside me and tried his best to bring back the smile I had lost.

He never let me face my pain alone.

As the days passed, he watched me sink deeper into silence.

Finally...

Unable to bear seeing me like that anymore, he decided to do something.

Without telling me, he called Kiran and explained everything.

He told him how badly I had changed.

How I barely smiled anymore.

How I had slowly stopped being myself.

Kiran understood the situation immediately.

A little while later...

My phone rang.

It was Kiran.

The moment I saw his name on the screen, a small spark of hope returned.

Maybe...

This time...

He was finally going to tell me the truth.

I answered the call almost instantly.

"Kiran..."

"Please."

"Tell me everything."

"I want to know everything that happened after we joined Intermediate."

There was silence for a few seconds.

Then Kiran finally began.

________________________________________

"Ever since Shreya joined college..."

"Karthik became very close to her."

"I noticed them together almost every day."

"Their friendship felt... different."

"Something about it didn't seem normal."

"So one day..."

"I asked Karthik directly."

"'Is there something going on between you and Shreya?'"

"He immediately denied it."

"'No,' he said."

"'There's nothing between us.'"

"I believed him."

Kiran paused for a moment before continuing.

"Then you came to me."

"You told me that you loved Shreya."

"For a moment..."

"I wanted to warn you."

"But I had no proof."

"I wasn't sure whether I was simply misunderstanding their friendship."

"So, I stayed quiet."

"Later..."

"You told me that Shreya would never do anything to hurt you."

"The confidence in your voice made me believe that perhaps I had judged her unfairly."

"So, I let the matter go."

His voice gradually became heavier.

"But a few weeks later..."

"Some of Karthik's friends told me that he and Shreya were actually in a relationship."

"I couldn't believe it."

"So, I confronted Karthik once again."

"He denied it."

"Again."

"But this time..."

"I didn't back down."

"I kept questioning him."

"I forced him to tell me the truth."

"After several minutes..."

"He finally admitted it."

"He said..."

"'Yes.'"

"'Shreya and I are in a relationship.'"

For a few moments, only the mountain breeze could be heard as Siddu continued recalling Kiran's words.

"Kiran told me that he wanted to hear the truth from Shreya herself."

"So, he decided to ask her the very next day."

"But before he could..."

"Karthik somehow came to know about it."

"And he informed Shreya."

"From the very next day..."

"She stopped coming to college."

________________________________________

A deep silence settled between Siddu and Sneha.

The cold mountain breeze gently swept past them.

Sneha remained quiet, trying to connect every piece of the story she had heard so far.

Then something suddenly struck her.

She slowly turned toward Siddu.

"Wait..."

"Is that why..."

"Shreya disappeared after your first year of Intermediate?"

Siddu looked down for a few moments.

A faint sadness filled his eyes.

Then he slowly nodded.

"Yes."

His single word carried far more pain than any long explanation ever could.
